title: Nurul Zahirah’s Portfolio
text:
Hi, I’m Nurul Zahirah, a penultimate year student pursuing BSc (Hons) in Applied Computing (Fintech) at Singapore Institute of Technology.


I’m passionate about data analytics, fintech innovation, and leveraging technology to solve real-world problems. Currently, I’m interning at Singapore Airlines, working with AI systems and data science.




Data Analytics: Experienced with Python, SQL, Alteryx, and Power BI
Fintech: Building solutions at the intersection of finance and technology
Automation: Creating efficient workflows with UiPath and RPA





Data Analyst Intern at KPMG Singapore - Achieved 80% efficiency improvements through Alteryx automation
Data Science Intern at Singapore Airlines - Worked on AI systems and data analytics




Here is my Favourite Photo taken in 2025, location: Great Ocean Road, Melbourne


Feel free to explore my projects and visualizations!
